Plumbing Solutions for Alameda and Contra Costa Counties
Savior Plumbing Inc has been the trusted name in plumbing services for Alameda and Contra Costa counties since 2000. With over two decades of experience, our team of skilled journeyman plumbers delivers exceptional residential and commercial plumbing solutions. We take pride in our commitment to integrity, fair pricing, and customer satisfaction, which has earned us the distinction of being voted the best in Pleasanton, CA, and achieving Diamond Certification for 14 consecutive years.
We offer same-day appointments whenever possible. Our bilingual team, fluent in both English and Spanish, ensures clear communication with all our clients. We stand behind our work with a comprehensive 2-year labor warranty, giving you peace of mind long after the job is completed. As a family-owned and locally operated business, we're deeply invested in our community and committed to providing reliable, high-quality plumbing services that meet the unique needs of each customer. Call or text us today.
Why Savior Plumbing is Your Trusted Plumbing Partner
Fair Pricing
Over 25 Years of Experience
2-Year Labor Warranty
Some Same-Day Appointments
Our team of trained journeyman plumbers brings over 25 years of combined experience to every job, ensuring that your plumbing issues are resolved efficiently and effectively. We pride ourselves on our transparent pricing policy and our commitment to providing free estimates for most services, with next-business-day quotes for more complex projects.
Our Diamond Certification and consistent recognition as the best in Pleasanton speak volumes about our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We don't just fix plumbing problems; we build lasting relationships with our clients, always striving to do things the right way and exceed expectations.

Residential Plumbing
Our experienced team is equipped to handle everything from routine maintenance to complex installations, ensuring your home's plumbing system operates smoothly and efficiently. We understand the importance of a well-functioning plumbing system in your daily life and work to deliver lasting solutions.

Commercial Plumbing
We recognize the unique challenges faced by commercial properties and provide tailored solutions to keep your operations running smoothly. Our team is adept at handling large-scale projects and complex systems, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum efficiency.

Water Heaters
Savior Plumbing is your source for all water heater needs. From installation to repairs and maintenance , we keep your water heating system operates at peak efficiency. Our technicians are well-versed in various types of water heaters including tank, tankless, and hybrid models.
